## Verdict

**Kelp** costs least for a team of 8, at **$168 per month**. It has the highest per-seat rate on the list, but it is the only vendor whose minimum (1 seat) falls below the team size, so the team pays for exactly 8 seats. Acme Desk bills for 20 seats and Fennel HQ for 40, and those floors more than wipe out their cheaper headline rates at this headcount.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $11 | 20 |
| Fennel HQ | $15 | 40 |
| Kelp | $21 | 1 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 8 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Kelp:** minimum 1 < 8, so 8 seats paid. 8 × $21 = **$168 per month**. Effective rate $21.00 per person.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 20 > 8, so 20 seats paid. 20 × $11 = **$220 per month**. Twelve unused seats, worth $132. Effective rate $27.50 per person ($220 ÷ 8).
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 40 > 8, so 40 seats paid. 40 × $15 = **$600 per month**. Thirty-two unused seats, worth $480. Effective rate $75.00 per person ($600 ÷ 8).

Kelp is $52 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $432 per month cheaper than Fennel HQ — $624 and $5,184 over twelve months.

## Risks

**This ranking is fragile and flips with modest growth.** Kelp wins only because of the seat minimums, not because it is cheaply priced. Acme Desk's $220 is fixed up to 20 seats, so it overtakes Kelp once the team reaches 11 people (11 × $21 = $231 > $220). Fennel HQ's $600 floor holds to 40 seats, at which point it is $15 per seat against Kelp's $21. If the team is expected to pass roughly 10 or 11 people within the contract term, re-run these figures before signing.

**Price only.** The list gives per-seat rates and minimums and nothing else — no features, support tiers, usage limits or security terms. The cheapest option at this size is also the most expensive per seat, which is worth noting if the vendors differ in what a seat includes.

**Billing terms as stated.** All figures assume monthly billing at list price. Annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees and exit terms are not on the price list and could reorder the result. Confirm also whether minimums are enforced only at signup or persist if headcount falls.
